conventions: One entry per code and side. Side A is the front, side B the back of a double-sided card; a shadow effect is a line of side A.

lines are the ability text of the text box in print order, one ability per line: no title, traits, stats, flavor text, or Victory line. Keyword lines (Surge., Doomed 1., Time 4., Capture 1.) stay, a keyword on its own line: one followed by more text (Time 4. Forced: ..., Indestructible. Cannot have attachments.) is split.
Icons are written as the words Hall of Beorn uses (Willpower, Attack, Defense, Threat). Apostrophes and quotation marks are straight.
A printed typo is written corrected in lines, and the printed wording is kept under misprints.
inert lists line numbers that need no effect record, with the reason. A line that is only keywords the engine reads is owned by the keyword.

A quest stage's card side B is its stage B. A double-sided card of the Campaign Expansion whose sides are two catalog cards (Protect the Innocent 10158 and Arnor Ravaged 100158) is each side A of its own code.

A campaign card's side A opens with the marker line "You are playing campaign mode." (Treachery of Rhudaur's holds only that line); its side B holds the Resolution paragraphs, each paragraph one line. Flavor text under the rules is not a line.

The scan of a Lost Realm or Adventure Pack card is the 2014 or 2015 printing (no MEC108 rewording can be found from these scans, so MEC108_CHANGED in scripts/data/printed/scope.ts stays empty until a scan of the MEC108 cards is read); the Campaign Expansion's own cards are read from their MEC108 scans (lotr.cardgame.tools).
